records.title: Thirty million crowns requested for pay and purchases in Hungary
records.header_literal: B) LP v NKJ (07.21 p.m., November 9th; 1810 VON UKS 3 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-190
records.readable_german: OHL. OKM bittet fuer Loehnung und Ankauf in Ungarn um schleunige Sendung von dreissig Millionen Kronen mittels
records.meaning: The message requests thirty million crowns for pay and purchases in Hungary. The means of transport and destination follow in the second source part.
notes: The raw SCHREUNIGE becomes SCHLEUNIGE through one observed-coordinate substitution. The invalid C in DGVXC is retained as a source slot and filled only in the edited reading.
The amount is spelled out as DREISSIG MILLIONEN, so thirty million is a direct word reading; no digit permutation is needed to obtain it.
The full 190-slot source frame is native. Earlier OCR lost several letter forms; the printed coordinate count itself needs no insertion, exclusion or reordering.

records.title: A giant aircraft to Brasso and a mix of banknote denominations
records.readable_german: Riesenflugzeug nach Brasso, deutsche Etappen Verwaltung. Angemessene Verteilung in grossen und kleinen Noten
records.meaning: The continuation specifies giant-aircraft transport to Brasso and the German Etappenverwaltung, and asks for an appropriate distribution between large and small banknotes.
notes: All 192 printed coordinates directly decode with no repair. The final visible DX was omitted by earlier OCR and is restored to the transcript, not inserted into the source.
The internal space in printed DG DGX does not add or remove a coordinate; all five letters belong to the group.
The recipient designation is preserved as the transmitted DEUTSCHE ETAPPEN VERWALTUNG without changing its case endings.

records.title: A limited crown supply and a high exchange rate
records.header_literal: 3 TL RICHI-144; following source control: NKJ DD
records.readable_german: erbeten. Kronen Vorat hier beschraenkt und hoch im Kurse. OK Mackensen 4A Nr 41942.
records.meaning: The final part finishes the request and reports that crown stocks are limited and their exchange rate high. The literal 4A and 41942 labels are retained without authenticating a historical reference number.
notes: The 144-slot body ends at VDXF. The following NKJ DD is a separately printed transmission control, not part of the encrypted body; the earlier OCR incorrectly appended DD.
The decoded spelling VORAT has one R and is preserved as Vorat. Inserting a second R in the readable display would change the letter stream.
This is a request and contemporaneous report, not evidence that thirty million crowns were actually delivered.

records.title: Urgent Constantinople embassy address signed Stumm
records.header_literal: E) XYZ v LP (06.43 a.m., November 10th; 0022 (9/11) 2 TEILE; 1 TL RICHI-98
records.readable_german: Deutsche Botschaft Constantinopel. Dringend. Gez. Stumm.
records.meaning: A separately received address and urgency line names the German embassy at Constantinople and the signature Stumm. Its second advertised part is not printed here.
notes: An enlarged source crop resolves the third glyph of XGGVX as G, including its visible internal bar. All 98 source coordinates directly decode without a fill.
CONSTANTINOPEL starts with C in this decoded stream and is not silently normalized to the K spelling of another record.
The source advertises two parts but supplies only this first part. A substantive telegram body is not reconstructed from its address alone.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.
